source_window: target week W reads regular-season week W-1 only; nothing from week >= W

acquisition.page: SIS NFL Player Leaderboards, Pass Defense Totals

analyzer: the parent protocol's per-artifact checks (hash, name, rows, schema, submitted scope, spec, CSV scope, API identities unique at (player, team) with season 2026, week W-1 and Games 1, CSV/API identity parity, numeric validity with yards allowed negative) without the 144-artifact grid or the 32-team union; exactly the two W-1 artifacts; 2 <= requests used <= 4

import.append: append-once; an identical re-run is a no-op; a different source_sha256 for an existing key fails closed
import.completeness: every team scheduled in regular-season week W-1 must appear as a defense in the union of both alignments and every (defense, offense) pair must be scheduled, otherwise nothing is archived or appended
import.archive: licensed/sis/receiver-copula/season=2026/week=<W-1, two digits>/sha256=<sha256>/<artifact>, created once; a re-run verifies the stored bytes
import.write: only with --write; without it the import is audit-only (no archive, no append)

defense_prior.input: every warehouse player-game row strictly before (2026, W), crossing seasons, plus this import's W-1 rows
defense_prior.unsupported_cells: recorded (context_supported false) and appended; never a failed import
defense_prior.withheld: the target-week prior is not written while any 2026 source week 1..W-1 is absent from the warehouse; the withheld weeks are recorded
defense_prior.source_sha256: sha256 of the newline-joined sorted distinct source_sha256 values of every player-game row the prior read
defense_prior.append: append-once by prior key; a different source_sha256 for an existing key fails closed

outcome_blind_first_run: the first run records rows and manifests only; no reader of the 2026 rows or the 2026 prior is added by this protocol and nothing on the money path reads either table
